summary: June CPI cooled to 3.8% (trimmed mean 3.6% below the RBA's 3.8% projection), taking an August hike off the table and sparking a rate-sensitive rally. CSL +7.15% led Healthcare on a plasma update; consumer-discretionary and homebuilding surged. RIO +3.67% on 1H results. MP1 -8.4% / WBT -8.3% hit by the global chip selloff. Large caps Bullish but XSO Small Ords still Bearish.
